Central subsidy up to Rs. 78,000 per household

applicationSteps.action: Register on https://pmsuryaghar.gov.in with electricity consumer number and mobile OTP
Fill application form, select capacity, upload electricity bill and roof photo
DISCOM conducts technical feasibility check and approves sanctioned load
Select empanelled vendor from portal list and complete rooftop solar PV installation
DISCOM inspects installation and installs bi-directional net meter
System commissioning report issued by DISCOM and subsidy credited directly via DBT to bank account

faqs.question: What is PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana?
faqs.answer: PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana is a Government of India scheme aiming to provide up to 300 units of free electricity per month to 1 crore households by installing rooftop solar PV systems, with Central financial assistance (subsidy) up to Rs. 78,000.

faqs.question: Who is eligible for PM Surya Ghar scheme?
faqs.answer: Any residential electricity consumer in India with an active DISCOM electricity connection and a suitable shadow-free rooftop (approx 10 sq.m per 1 kW) is eligible.

faqs.question: How much subsidy is provided under PM Surya Ghar?
faqs.answer: The subsidy structure is: Rs. 30,000 for 1 kW, Rs. 60,000 for 2 kW, and Rs. 78,000 for 3 kW and above. The subsidy is transferred directly to your bank account via DBT.

faqs.question: How long does it take from application to receiving subsidy?
faqs.answer: The complete workflow from online application on pmsuryaghar.gov.in to technical feasibility, installation, net-metering commissioning, and DBT subsidy credit takes approximately 60 to 90 days.

faqs.question: Can I sell surplus solar electricity back to the grid?
faqs.answer: Yes. Through net metering, any surplus solar energy generated and fed back into the DISCOM grid is credited against your electricity bill, reducing or eliminating your monthly charges.

faqs.question: Are collateral-free bank loans available for installing rooftop solar?
faqs.answer: Yes. Leading public and private banks offer collateral-free solar loans at concessional interest rates (~7% p.a.) for covering the remaining consumer portion after subsidy.

faqs.question: Can tenants apply for PM Surya Ghar rooftop solar?
faqs.answer: Yes, provided the tenant submits a signed No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the property owner along with the electricity bill and application.

faqs.question: What is the toll-free helpline number for PM Surya Ghar?
faqs.answer: The official national toll-free helpline number is 1800-180-3333 or 15555.
